note: POST /campaigns/{id}/groups: an empty group. Keyed: live names are unique, so an unkeyed retry of a create that landed would be 409 group_name_taken. A repeat of the key answers 201 with the group it made, whatever name the repeat sends. The server's check_group_name (the alias rules) is stricter than this shape and refuses the rest with the same 422.

valid.name: a name trimmed as the client trims

invalid.name: no command_id
invalid.why: a create is keyed, so a retried create cannot answer 409 for the group it made

invalid.name: a command_id of 15 characters
invalid.why: a key is 16 to 64 URL-safe characters

invalid.name: a name past 40
invalid.why: 0019's CHECK on groups.name: 40 code points after trimming

invalid.name: a lone surrogate in the name
invalid.why: JSON allows the escape; UTF-8 does not, so the name could be neither stored nor answered. Refused here it is a 422, not a 500

invalid.name: a bidirectional override in the name
invalid.why: stored text refuses what changes what a reader sees (lead ruling of 2026-09-21): a GM choosing an audience must read the name that is stored

invalid.name: members in the create
invalid.why: a create makes an empty group; each member is added on its own, each its own locked widening (RQ-4)

invalid.name: a newer schema_version
invalid.why: the version this contract speaks is 1
